full_prompt_en: A square graphic-novel portrait shows a fair-haired young woman looking back over her shoulder against a dark purple field and an ornate golden circle. The background is a flat but richly patterned violet plane, darkest at the corners, with a broad circular motif centered behind her head. Thin gold lines and small curling ornaments fill the ring, giving a decorative frame to the otherwise close character study. The woman occupies most of the lower and central frame, with her head turned toward the viewer from a body angled to the right. Smooth blond hair is drawn back from the forehead and gathers behind the head, with a long section falling along the right shoulder. Large dark eyes look outward from beneath gently arched brows, and her lips remain slightly parted. The nose, cheeks, and chin are shaped from crisp planes of warm beige, pale rose, and deep mauve shadow, producing a sculpted comic-book clarity. A dark blue jacket fills the lower-right foreground over a white collared shirt and a narrow burgundy tie. The jacket's shoulder cuts diagonally across the bottom, anchoring the round motif above. Fine dark outlines sharpen the eyes, hair strands, collar, and the outer edge of the face; larger color areas remain clean and almost poster-like. Warm illumination reaches the face from the upper left, lifting the forehead and cheek while the far side of the jaw drops into violet-brown shade. The gold ring glows quietly rather than throwing a separate cast shadow. The overall composition is alert and iconic, balancing a close turned face, circular ornament, and deep jewel-tone color in a polished illustrated portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图像小说式肖像描绘一位浅发年轻女子在深紫色底面和华丽金色圆环前回头望来。背景是一片平坦却纹样丰富的紫罗兰色区域，四角最暗，头后方居中有一道宽阔圆形图案。纤细金线与小小的卷曲装饰填满圆环，为近距离人物刻画提供装饰边框。女子占据中下部大部分，身体朝右斜，头部却转向观者。平顺金发从额头向后梳起，聚在脑后，长长一段沿右肩落下。大而深色的眼睛从柔和弯眉下看向画外，嘴唇微微张开。鼻子、面颊和下颌由暖米色、浅玫瑰色及深紫褐阴影的清晰色面塑造，呈现漫画般有雕塑感的明晰度。深蓝外套覆在白色翻领衬衫和窄酒红色领带外，占据右下前景。外套肩线斜切过下缘，固定上方的圆形纹样。细深色轮廓强化眼睛、发丝、衣领和脸部外缘；更大的色面仍干净而近乎海报化。暖光从左上方落在脸上，提亮前额和面颊，远侧下颌沉入紫褐色阴影。金色圆环安静发亮，并不投下独立的阴影。整体构图警觉而具有图标感，以精细插画肖像中的近距离回望面孔、圆形装饰和深宝石色互相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The graphic illustration uses crisp contour lines and broad, clean planes of jewel-toned color. Warm beige and pale rose highlights stand against violet, burgundy, deep blue, and narrow gold accents. Faces and curved volumes are modeled through stepped shadow shapes rather than continuous photographic blending, creating a polished comic-book depth. Fine linework concentrates at expression points and ornamental edges, while larger regions remain quiet and flat. A circular patterned field behind a close focal mass creates a strong centered hierarchy; diagonal lower forms keep it from feeling static. Lighting is warm from one side, with cool purple-brown shadow planes and no heavy realistic cast shadow. The overall effect is dramatic and iconic, joining detailed graphic character work with restrained decorative symmetry.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画使用清楚的轮廓线和宽阔干净的宝石色色面。暖米色与浅玫瑰色亮部立在紫罗兰、酒红、深蓝和狭窄金色重音前。面部及弯曲体积由阶梯式阴影色面塑造，而非连续的摄影晕染，形成精致的漫画纵深。细线集中在表情关键处和装饰边缘，更大的区域保持安静平坦。近距离焦点体块后方的圆形纹样区域建立强烈居中层级，下方斜向形体使它不会呆板。光从一侧暖暖照来，配冷调紫褐色阴影平面，没有浓重写实投影。整体效果戏剧化而具有图标感，把细致的图形人物刻画与克制的装饰对称结合起来。
theme_en: A fair-haired young woman looking back before a purple-gold patterned circle
theme_zh: 一位浅发年轻女子在紫金圆形纹样前回望
name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
